```{r Data Import, include=FALSE}
## Packages

### Survey Season Summary 2026.R Code
rm(list=ls())

library(lubridate)
library(ggplot2)
library(patchwork)
library(scales)
library(cli)
library(reprex)
library(tidyverse)
library(geosphere)
library(reshape2)
library(moderndive)
library(skimr)
library(ggridges)
library(GGally)
library(psych)
library(raster)
library(PBSmapping)
library(sf)
library(terra)
library(knitr)
library(kableExtra)
library(grid)
library(gridExtra)
library(cowplot)
library(DT)
library(dygraphs)
library(leaflet)
library(rmapshaper)
library(plotly)
library(mapproj)
library(oce)
library(pander)
library(janitor)
library(dplyr)


repo <-  file.path(
  path.expand("~"),
  "GitHub",
  "HerringScience.github.io"
)

SSB <- read.csv(file.path(repo,
                          "Main Data",
                          "SSB Estimates.csv"))

### Group SSB into grounds, then adding the HSC biomass with turnover for each invidual ground by year. Count the number of surveys in each year by ground.

SSB <- SSB %>%
  group_by(Year, Ground) %>%
  filter(Year>2016)

SurveyNumbers <- SSB %>%
  count(Year, Ground) %>%
  rename("No. Of Surveys" = n)

#Below isn't saving for some reason.

#write.csv(SurveyNumbers, "Survey Numbers per Year.csv", row.names = FALSE)

SSB_summary <- SSB %>%
  mutate(
    Biomass = case_when(
      Ground == "Seal Island" ~ as.numeric(HSC_Estimate),
      TRUE ~ coalesce(
        as.numeric(HSC_Turnover_Adjusted),
        as.numeric(DFO_Turnover_Adjusted)
      )
    ),
    Biomass_Source = case_when(
      Ground == "Seal Island" ~ "Seal_HSC_No_Turnover",
      !is.na(as.numeric(HSC_Turnover_Adjusted)) ~ "HSC_Turnover_Adjusted",
      !is.na(as.numeric(DFO_Turnover_Adjusted)) ~ "DFO_Turnover_Adjusted",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  ) %>%
  group_by(Year, Ground) %>%
  summarise(
    Total_Biomass = sum(Biomass, na.rm = TRUE),
    Source = paste(unique(Biomass_Source), collapse = ", "),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

Source_Summary <- SSB_summary %>%
  group_by(Year) %>%
  summarise(
    Source = paste(
      sort(unique(Source)),
      collapse = " + "
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

SSB_summary <- full_join (
  SSB_summary,
  SurveyNumbers,
  by = (c("Year", "Ground")
     )
)

SSB_summary <- SSB_summary %>%
  select(Year, Ground, Total_Biomass) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = Ground,
    values_from = Total_Biomass
  )
  

LRP_build <- SSB_summary %>%
  mutate(
   Biomass = `Scots Bay` + `German Bank`) %>%
  mutate(`LRP` = 317846)


LRP_build <- LRP_build %>%
  arrange(Year) %>%
  mutate(
    `3yr Avg` = (
      Biomass +
        lag(Biomass, 1) +
        lag(Biomass, 2)
    )/3
    )

LRP_build <- LRP_build %>%
  mutate(
    `w Seal Biomass` = `Biomass` + `Seal Island`)


LRP_build <- LRP_build %>%
  arrange(Year) %>%
  mutate(
    `w Seal 3yr Avg` = (
      `w Seal Biomass` +
        lag(`w Seal Biomass`, 1) +
        lag(`w Seal Biomass`, 2)
    )/3
    )

LRP_build <- LRP_build %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), round))

LRP_HSC <-
  full_join(
    LRP_build, 
    Source_Summary, 
    by = c("Year"))

#From 2017 to use exclusively HSC numbers.

LRP_HSC <- LRP_HSC %>%
  filter(Year >= 2017)


```

# {.tabset}

## SSB Estimates {.tabset}

### LRP Data {.tabset}

#### Total

`Scots Bay and German Bank herring biomass, using HSC biomass numbers only. Scots Bay and German Bank have had turnover applied.`

```{r echo=FALSE}
LRP_HSC %>% dplyr::select(Year, Biomass, LRP, `3yr Avg`) %>%
  dygraph(ylab = "Biomass (mt)", xlab = "Year") %>%
  dyOptions(drawPoints = TRUE, pointSize = 2) %>%
  dyHighlight(highlightCircleSize = 5, 
              highlightSeriesBackgroundAlpha = 0.8,
              hideOnMouseOut = FALSE)
```

`Herring biomass including Seal Island. using HSC biomass numbers only. Scots Bay and German Bank have had turnover applied. Seal Island biomass numbers do NOT include turn over as this was a recent addition to the index.`

```{r echo=FALSE}
LRP_HSC %>% dplyr::select(Year, `w Seal Biomass`, LRP, `w Seal 3yr Avg`) %>%
  filter(!is.na(`w Seal Biomass`)) %>%
  dygraph(ylab = "Biomass (mt)", xlab = "Year") %>%
  dyOptions(drawPoints = TRUE, pointSize = 2) %>%
  dyHighlight(highlightCircleSize = 5, 
              highlightSeriesBackgroundAlpha = 0.8,
              hideOnMouseOut = FALSE)
```

`Scots Bay and German Bank herring biomass using HSC biomass numbers only. Scots Bay and German Bank have had turnover applied.`

```{r echo=FALSE}
LRP3 = LRP_HSC %>%
  dplyr::select(Year, `Scots Bay`, `German Bank`, Biomass, LRP, ThreeYear="3yr Avg") %>%
  mutate(Difference = ThreeYear-LRP)

LRP3 %>% arrange(desc(Year)) %>%
  datatable(colnames = c("Year", "Scots Bay", "German Bank","Biomass (mt)", "LRP", "3yr Avg", "Difference"),
  extensions = 'Buttons',
  options = list(
  pageLength = 5,
  dom = 'lfrtiBp', 
  buttons = c('copy', 'csv', 'excel', 'pdf', 'print'))) %>%
  formatStyle(columns = "Difference", color = styleInterval(cuts = 0, values = c("red", "green")))
```

`Herring biomass including Seal Island using HSC biomass numbers only. Scots Bay and German Bank have had turnover applied. Seal Island biomass numbers do NOT include turnover as this was a recent addition to the index.`

```{r echo=FALSE}
LRP3 = LRP_HSC %>%
  dplyr::select(Year, `Scots Bay`, `German Bank`, `Seal Island`, `w Seal Biomass`, LRP, ThreeYear = `w Seal 3yr Avg`) %>%
  mutate(Difference = ThreeYear-LRP) %>%
  filter(!is.na(`Seal Island`))

LRP3 %>% arrange(desc(Year)) %>%
  datatable(colnames = c("Year", "Scots Bay", "German Bank", "Seal Isl.", "Biomass incl. Seal (mt)", "LRP", "3yr Avg incl. Seal", "Difference"),
  extensions = 'Buttons',
  options = list(
  pageLength = 5,
  dom = 'lfrtiBp', 
  buttons = c('copy', 'csv', 'excel', 'pdf', 'print'))) %>%
  formatStyle(columns = "Difference", color = styleInterval(cuts = 0, values = c("red", "green")))
```

### Total SSB Summaries {.tabset}

#### Total

`HSC spawning stock biomass estimates for Scots Bay and German Bank.`

```{r echo=FALSE}

Plot_Summary <- SSB %>%
  filter(Ground %in% c("Scots Bay", "German Bank")) %>%
  mutate(
    Biomass = case_when(
      Ground == "Seal Island" ~ as.numeric(HSC_Estimate),
      TRUE ~ coalesce(
        as.numeric(HSC_Turnover_Adjusted)
      )
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(Biomass)) %>%
  group_by(Ground, Year) %>%
  summarise(
    Biomass = sum(Biomass, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

p <- ggplot(Plot_Summary, aes(x = factor(Year), y = Biomass, fill = Ground)) +
  geom_col() +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = comma) +
  labs(
    x = "Year",
    y = "HSC Estimate w/ Turnover"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 55, hjust = 1),
    legend.position = "right"
  )


print(p)

Table = SSB %>%
  filter(Ground == "Scots Bay" | Ground == "German Bank") %>%
  filter(!is.na(HSC_Turnover_Adjusted)) %>%
  group_by(Year) %>%
  summarize(HSC_Estimate = sum(HSC_Estimate),
            HSC_Turnover_Adjusted = sum(HSC_Turnover_Adjusted),
            #DFO_Estmate = sum(DFO_Estimate),
            #DFO_Turnover_Adjusted = sum(DFO_Turnover_Adjusted)
            ) %>%
  arrange(desc(Year))

datatable(Table, 
          colnames = c("Year", "HSC Estimate", "HSC w/ Turnover"
                       #, "DFO Estimate", "DFO w/ Turnover"
                       ), 
          extensions = 'Buttons',
  options = list(
  pageLength = 5,
  dom = 'lfrtiBp', 
  buttons = c('copy', 'csv', 'excel', 'pdf', 'print')))

```
`HSC spawning stock biomass estimates for Scots Bay, German Bank and Seal Island. Turnover does not include Seal Island. The total estimate provided will be artificially high due to no turnover being applied to Seal Island.`

### Annual SSB Estimates {.tabset}

#### Scots Bay {.tabset .tabset-pills}

```{r, results = "asis", fig.align='center'}
HSCSSB = SSB %>% dplyr::select(Year, Ground, Survey_Number, HSC_Turnover_Adjusted) %>%
  filter(!is.na(HSC_Turnover_Adjusted))

for(i in unique(HSCSSB$Year)) {
  cat("\n")
  cat("##### ", i, "\n")
  cat("\n")
  
  
print(ggplot(data=subset(HSCSSB, Ground == "Scots Bay" & Year == i), aes(x=Survey_Number, y=HSC_Turnover_Adjusted, group=1)) +
  geom_point(stat='summary', fun.y=sum) +
  stat_summary(fun.y=sum, geo="line") +
  labs(x="Survey Number", y="HSC Biomass w/ Turnover"))
  cat("\n")
  print(kbl(x=subset(HSCSSB, Ground == "Scots Bay" & Year == i), align = "c", col.names = c("Year", "Ground", "Survey Number", "HSC (Turnover Adjusted)")) %>%
          kable_paper("striped", full_width = F))
  cat("\n")
}
```
